received: Got your Amazon link, checking the price now...
invalid_url: Please send the link of the Amazon product page: open the product, tap Share, and send that link.
unsupported_site: This Amazon site is not supported. Supported: {supported_sites}. Please send a product link from one of these sites.
product_unavailable: This product isn't available on Amazon for us right now (sold out or not shipped here). If you picked a size or colour, send the link of that exact option, or send another product.
region_not_allowed: This Amazon link is from a region our account does not allow. Please send a link from an allowed region.
region_unverified: We couldn't verify this product's region. Please open the product on {site} and send its link again.
staff_follow_up: Thanks! We'll get back to you with the price shortly.
pricing_failed: We couldn't price this product right now. Please send the link again in a few minutes.
expired: The quote timed out. Please send the link again.
items_unavailable: The items are unavailable. Please send a new link.
temporary_problem: There is a temporary pricing problem. Please send the link again in a few minutes.
